activity.notes: Jacques Delors became President of the European Commission on 7 January 1985, when the supranational polity was still the European Communities. ATLAS ends this phase on 1 November 1993, the entry into force of the Maastricht Treaty and formal creation of the European Union.

sources.title: European Union — Key dates in European integration
sources.citation_text: The EU chronology records Jacques Delors becoming President of the Commission on 7 January 1985.

sources.title: European Commission — Jacques Delors
sources.citation_text: The Commission records Delors as President for three terms from January 1985 to the end of 1994.
